plugins.name: clean-core-skills
plugins.description: A knowledge-base assistant for Enterprise Architects and Architecture Advisors at SAP. Covers all five SAP Clean Core principles — Extensibility, Integration, Data, Business Processes, and Operations. Start with clean-core-general for overview and cross-cutting questions; use the principle-specific skills for deep guidance. Also generates ATC assessment dashboards from SAP ATC findings exports.
